AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)

   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
